{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican Party applauds President Bush for vigorously enforcing the law to deter and punish corporate abuses.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush established an interagency Corporate Fraud Task Force to investigate and prosecute financial crimes, recover the proceeds of those crimes, and hold corporate criminals to account.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over 700 violators have been charged and over 300 convictions or guilty pleas secured by the Corporate Fraud Task Force since it was established two years ago, including more than 25 former CEOs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More than $1 billion in forfeited funds has been recovered from corporate wrongdoers for return to defrauded creditors and investors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The enforcement budget of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has more than doubled.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The SEC has issued new rules to ban late-trading and other fraudulent practices engaged in by certain mutual funds.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Americans can trust that corporate executives who operate outside the law will be prosecuted thanks to swift and decisive action by President Bush and the Congress.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
